name: Organized Glitter
description: A multi-craft project tracker for hobbyists who actually finish things.
northStar: The Quiet Notebook. iOS Settings restraint plus Apple Notes warmth, with Caveat-handwritten H1s as the personal-library signature. Glass is a structural means to that feel, never decoration. The page uses a viewport-fixed Berry Cream atmosphere; chrome stays flat.

tokenSystem.format: Tailwind v4 @theme inline + HSL CSS custom properties
tokenSystem.rationale: Hex frontmatter is for Stitch tooling compatibility; HSL is canonical in source. Keep docs aligned to src/index.css unless the token system migrates.

primary.role: Berry Cream primary. Used on the single high-emphasis CTA per region.

primary-dark-mode.role: Berry Cream after dark raspberry for the same semantic role.

accent.role: Purple accent reserved for selected states and deliberate emphasis.

destructive.role: Filled destructive controls in Light. Standalone danger text uses the same red.

destructive-dark-mode.role: Filled destructive controls in Dark (`--destructive`). Same fill as Light; pair with destructive-foreground.

destructive-text-dark-mode.role: Standalone danger text in Dark (`--destructive-text` / `text-destructive-text`). Do not use the fill token for text.

background-dark.role: Berry Cream after dark navy page surface. Lifted from the iOS #05051A stage for readability on larger screens.

aurora-purple.role: Deprecated. Aurora atmosphere retired; tokens kept for archival reference only.

paper.scope: Marketing surfaces only (HomeHero subtree). Deliberately non-themed sub-system; same paper across Light and Dark.
paper.rationale: Real paper does not theme-shift. Dark-mode tokens soften against the navy stage while keeping their material identity. Dark marketing lets the product page atmosphere show behind paper surfaces.

washi.scope: Decorative tape strips on marketing surfaces only.
washi.rationale: Soft craft-paper tones. tape--lav bridges marketing into brand primary at low alpha.

fontStack.mono: JetBrains Mono Variable, ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, monospace

rules: Caveat appears once per page on the H1 only.
Karla everywhere else; weight contrast carries hierarchy.
Mobile inputs use 16px to defeat iOS Safari zoom-on-focus.

elevation.philosophy: Flat-by-default. Surfaces are flat at rest; shadow is a response to state, not baseline ornament. Glass earns depth from translucency plus a 1px inset highlight, not stacked drop shadows.
namedRules: Flat-By-Default Rule: shadow responds to state, never baseline.
One-Panel-Per-Region Rule: max one GlassPanel per page region; use Section helper inside.
Translucent-Not-Layered Rule: depth from translucency plus inset highlight, never stacked shadows or gradient backplates.

easings.comment: ease-out-quart for exits and reveals; no bounce, no elastic.

rules: Respect prefers-reduced-motion: reduce; the CSS already disables animate-spin-custom, animate-float, animate-glow-pulse under that media query.
Motion is never the only signal; status changes also update label, hue, and icon.

gradients.stance: Banned on chrome. The product body uses one documented atmosphere (`--page-atmosphere` on `.page-atmosphere`): Light blush-to-lilac wash, Dark navy plus quiet lavender bloom. No new gradients on buttons, panels, chips, headers, or state.

documented.name: page-atmosphere-light
documented.purpose: Match the iOS Berry Cream page wash.

documented.name: page-atmosphere-dark
documented.value: radial-gradient(ellipse 120% 76% at 50% 118%, hsl(271 28% 52% / 0.45) 0%, hsl(270 26% 34% / 0.22) 42%, transparent 72%) over navy --background
documented.purpose: Quiet lavender bloom for Berry Cream after dark. Lower saturation than the iOS grape hotspot.

documented.name: image-scrim
documented.purpose: Contrast under floating glass icon-buttons over user photos.

banned: Gradient borders or hover states on chrome

breakpoints.rationale: useIsPhone (640px) for tight-viewport-specific decisions like bottom-nav and 70dvh drawers; useIsMobile (1024px) reserved for tablet-and-below logic.

button-primary.html: <button type="button" class="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md bg-primary px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-primary-foreground shadow-xs transition-all hover:bg-primary/90 focus-visible:ring-[3px] focus-visible:ring-ring/50 focus-visible:outline-none">Save</button>
button-primary.css: .button-primary { background: hsl(var(--primary)); color: hsl(var(--primary-foreground)); border-radius: 10px; height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; transition: all 240ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); }
button-primary.usage: One per region, single high-emphasis action.

button-glass.html: <button type="button" class="inline-flex h-9 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md border border-[hsl(var(--glass-border))] bg-[hsl(var(--glass-bg))] px-4 text-sm font-medium text-foreground shadow-[inset_0_1px_0_hsl(var(--glass-highlight))] backdrop-blur-xl backdrop-saturate-150 transition-all hover:brightness-110 focus-visible:ring-[3px] focus-visible:ring-ring/50 focus-visible:outline-none">Edit</button>
button-glass.css: .button-glass { background: hsl(var(--glass-bg)); border: 1px solid hsl(var(--glass-border)); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 hsl(var(--glass-highlight)); backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(150%); border-radius: 10px; height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; }
button-glass.usage: Secondary controls inside or near a GlassPanel. Do not use for top-bar Back, Edit, or overflow chrome; those are ghost buttons.

button-glass-destructive.html: <button type="button" class="inline-flex h-9 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md bg-destructive/80 px-4 text-sm font-medium text-white shadow-[inset_0_1px_0_hsl(var(--glass-highlight))] backdrop-blur-xl backdrop-saturate-150 transition-all hover:bg-destructive focus-visible:ring-[3px] focus-visible:ring-ring/50 focus-visible:outline-none">Remove</button>
button-glass-destructive.usage: Inline destructive actions. AlertDialog confirms need the className workaround (variant prop is dropped by shadcn).

panel.css: .glass-panel { background: hsl(var(--glass-bg)); border: 1px solid hsl(var(--glass-border)); border-radius: 16px; padding: 24px; backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(150%); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 hsl(var(--glass-highlight)), 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.08); }
panel.usage: Signature container. One per page region; use Section helper inside for grouped controls.

section.html:
Display

Sync
section.usage: Section rhythm inside panels. Hairline divider above every group except the first.

chip-status.html: In Progress
chip-status.usage: Status hue plus icon plus label. Never hue alone.

input-field.html: <input type="text" class="flex h-9 w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-card px-3 py-2 text-base md:text-sm shadow-xs transition-colors focus-visible:border-ring focus-visible:ring-[3px] focus-visible:ring-ring/50 focus-visible:outline-none" />
rules: Mobile font-size 16px to defeat iOS Safari zoom.
Date inputs left-align text to defeat iOS Safari centering.

bottom-nav.html: <nav class="fixed inset-x-0 bottom-0 grid grid-cols-5 border-t border-border/60 bg-[hsl(var(--glass-bg))] backdrop-blur-xl pb-[env(safe-area-inset-bottom)]" aria-label="Primary"><!-- 5 slots, slot 3 is centered creation CTA with bg-primary/10 --></nav>
rules: Slot 3 is the centered creation '+' CTA.

dashboard: DashboardShell owns the Caveat H1, craft SegmentedControl, and the single New project action.
Desktop filter sidebars use one GlassPanel; result grids and lists stay flat on the page surface.
Diamond, coloring book, and coloring page panes should share sidebar/content rhythm instead of feeling like separate apps.
randomizer: One main GlassPanel contains craft choice, eligibility filters, wheel, and result.
Desktop target selection and spin history are flat adjacent regions; mobile target selection folds into the main panel below the wheel.
The wheel is a deliberate full-palette data visualization exception with pattern overlays, a key, label fallbacks, and reduced-motion behavior. Do not reuse wheel colors as ordinary chrome.
coloringBooks: Book detail uses a cover-led flat header, ghost top chrome, SectionHeading region markers, and a dense page grid.
Book covers default to a 3:4 crop. Mystery is a small primary chip, not a hidden-card gimmick.
Publishers, illustrators, tags, and notes extend the shared library model rather than creating a separate app surface.
coloringPages: The artwork/photo canvas stays large and flat.
Status, dates, mediums, and mystery reveal live in one right-rail GlassPanel.
Page photos default to preserving the whole page because they are documentary records first.

accessibility.focusRing: 3px ring (focus-visible:ring-ring/50). Never outline: none without a replacement.
accessibility.colorIndependence: Status communicated by hue + icon + label. Never hue alone.
accessibility.reducedMotion: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce disables animate-spin-custom, animate-float, animate-glow-pulse via CSS media query.
accessibility.screenReaders: aria-label and aria-pressed on interactive status cards; type="button" unless intentionally submit/reset; lists announce position and total.

antiReferences: Literal craft-store aesthetic (bows, glitter graphics, scrapbook fonts, chalkboard, Cricut energy)
Generic SaaS dashboard (hero KPI tiles, gradient-accented metric cards, engagement framing)
AI slop tells (gradient hero text, identical card grids, drive-by glassmorphism, side-stripe colored borders)
Forum-era craft software (skeuomorphic notebooks, faux-leather, widget-panel sidebars)
